traffic_management.defaultSafety: Full structural/high-visibility PPE. Establish positive blocking apparatus positioning and sequential cone tapers prior to commencing work on roadway.

forcible_entry.defaultSafety: Safety glasses and heavy leather gloves mandatory. Control tool leverage points to prevent slips and clear bystanders from swing radius.

vehicle_extrication.defaultSafety: Full structural PPE with eye protection and heavy rescue gloves. Disconnect 12V/high-voltage power sources, crib vehicle securely before tool operation, and manage airbag deployment zones.
resources: Hydraulic Spreader, Cutter, and Ram Kit

driving.defaultSafety: Seatbelts mandatory for all crew members prior to apparatus movement. Comply with local provincial traffic laws and intersection protocols during emergency response modes.
resources: Traffic Cones for Chute / Parking Drills

pumping.defaultSafety: Wear eye protection and hearing protection when operating high-pressure pump panels. Secure all discharge lines and monitor relief valves/pressure governors.

interior_operations.defaultSafety: Full structural firefighting PPE with SCBA fully donned and checked prior to entering IDLH atmosphere. Maintain team integrity and monitor air management (PAR checks).
resources: Full Structural PPE & SCBA with Spare Cylinders

command_operations.defaultSafety: Establish formal Incident Command Post (ICP) in a safe, visible location outside the immediate hazard zone. Maintain accountability system (tag board/software).
resources: Portable Radios with Assigned Tactical Channels

technical_rescue.defaultSafety: Dual-path safety rope systems mandatory for all elevated or below-grade loads. Complete atmospheric monitoring and ventilation for confined spaces.

dangerous_goods.defaultSafety: Approach upwind and uphill. Maintain safe isolation distances utilizing the Emergency Response Guidebook (ERG) until chemical identification and monitoring are complete.

wildland_fire.defaultSafety: Wear certified wildland PPE (nomex, boots, helmets, shroud). Identify escape routes and safety zones (LACES protocol) prior to engaging flank or head of fire.
